blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday said the new solar pump irrigation project (SPIP) in Pamplona, Cagayan, could reduce monthly irrigation costs from P400,000 to as low as P50,000. Marcos made the remarks during the inauguration of the Pamplona SPIP in Barangay Gattu, which is designed to irrigate 602 hectares of farmland and benefit 307 farmers. READ: Marcos: Gov’t expanding use of solar-powered irrigation The facility is equipped with three 50-horsepower solar-powered submersible pumps, a photovoltaic system with 384 solar panels, and other operational equipment. “Dati, P300,000 to P400,000 ang buwanang gastos sa paggamit na traditional na irigasyon,” the President […]...
